meta_description: RGT Plumbing and Heating Services offer expert plumbing and heating solutions across Nottingham. Fast response, honest pricing. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Nottingham's Trusted Plumbers
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or heating faults fixed fast — RGT Plumbing keeps your home warm and worry-free.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full boiler installations, RGT Plumbing and Heating Services covers every need in your home or commercial property.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Upgrade to an energy-efficient boiler with a full professional installation. We advise on the best system for your property and handle everything from removal to commissioning.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with an annual service or rapid fault repair. We diagnose and fix issues quickly, minimising disruption to your household.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: From new system installations to power flushing and radiator upgrades, we ensure your heating runs at peak performance throughout the Nottingham winter.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or sudden loss of hot water won't wait — neither do we. RGT Plumbing offers fast-response emergency callouts across Nottingham.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: Transform your bathroom with a full suite installation carried out to the highest standard. We manage all plumbing and pipework so your new bathroom looks and functions perfectly.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repairs
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left unchecked. Our experienced engineers locate and repair leaks swiftly, protecting your home and keeping bills down.

about_pullquote: Every job we take on, we treat it as if it's our own home.
about_para_1: RGT Plumbing and Heating Services has been proudly serving homeowners and businesses across Nottingham for over a decade. Founded on a commitment to honest workmanship and fair pricing, the business has grown through word-of-mouth recommendation and a reputation for turning up on time and getting the job done right first time.
about_para_2: What sets RGT apart is a straightforward approach: clear communication, no hidden costs, and a tidy finish every time. Customers return because they trust us — and they recommend us to their neighbours, family, and friends across Nottingham and the surrounding areas.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About RGT Plumbing

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Called RGT on a Monday morning with a leaking pipe and they were with me within the hour. Friendly, professional, and left the place spotless. Will definitely be using them again.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced and a new radiator fitted. The engineer was knowledgeable, explained everything clearly, and the price was exactly as quoted with no nasty surprises. Highly recommend to anyone in Nottingham looking for a reliable plumber.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: RGT sorted our heating system before Christmas when our boiler packed in. They came out the same day and had us back up and running that evening. Couldn't be more grateful — excellent work at a fair price.
reviews.author: Michelle R.
